title: CandidateQuestionSet
description: CQC-P0 frozen artifact contract v0.1 (contract CQC-P0-MINIMAL-DIGESTION-SURFACE-v0.1 section 4-6).

artifact_id.description: Stable artifact identity, e.g. CQS-CQC-P0-A. No semantic meaning encoded.

source_narrative_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact UTF-8 bytes of the digested source narrative.

source_narrative.description: The verbatim source narrative used for digestion.

statement.description: Smallest useful scientific question; independently searchable, not a lexical fragment.

source_trace.description: Anti-drift field: every exact_quote must occur verbatim in source_narrative.

question_type.description: Provisional vocabulary as guidance, NOT a frozen ontology. Any non-empty string accepted.

dependencies.description: Prerequisite question_ids, only when they materially affect search order or interpretation.

resolution_condition.description: What evidence would materially resolve, falsify, narrow, or change the state of the question. Not a search plan.

uncertainty.description: Preserved ambiguity. null or free text only; no enum in P0.
